result:
**Verdict: PASS for DG0 round 29, with one new Low finding (F-DG0-015).** I checked candidate `sha256:84130c62…751bd` at commit `1e4c022`. The candidate ID recomputes to the same value both in the working tree and at the commit. Live HEAD is `ffa3fae`, which only adds metadata after the freeze. The repository and my disposable clones were complete (not shallow). I read no other round-29 review record.

Since round 28, the candidate changed only in the D-045 validator check (`rules.mjs`), its two tests and the D-045 row in `decisions.md`. The specification files have a 0-line diff. I re-ran every specification check anyway:

- **Extraction:** the playbook text is complete and verbatim (1001 of 1001 paragraphs and table cells, 49 tables, the docx SHA matches). The reproducibility check passes.
- **Coverage:** all 165 playbook blocks and all 423 master-prompt blocks have a disposition, with 0 mapping problems. I judged a sample of 78 master-prompt blocks across 23 sections, including table rows; the list is in `08-master-prompt-sample.out`.
- **Templates and deliverables:** T01–T16 columns and value lists, and all the first-class deliverables, are preserved. Anything not verbatim is formatting only (numbering, labels, quotes).
- **Provenance and branding:** nothing claims official PMI status, certification or official Mobily branding, and `#0078FF` is always marked provisional.
- **Operating logic:** each rule is in the register with a testable acceptance: RAG from the trajectory, delivery/adoption/validated value/closure as separate states, forecast never counted as validated, Finance validation, no double counting, evidence-snapshot gates, DG0–DG7 kept separate from G1–G6, and admins not approvers.
- **Staging:** no problems, and it matches §21.
- **Assigned rows:** REQ-DLV-001, 002, 020 and 032 meet their acceptance. The glossary, journeys and permissions matrix are complete and consistent.

**D-045 fix:**
- **Tests:** the gate tests pass 66/66, and gate plus agent tests pass 105/105. I removed the new check in a disposable clone and the D-045 test failed; with the check restored it passes.
- **Forge on the real history:** at baseline the validator reports no "object, not a commit" errors. When I replaced round 28's `source_commit` with an annotated tag, the validator reported the new D-045 error.
- **Census:** 27 of the round `source_commit` values present before round 29 are commits, and round 18 is the known missing one. All 120 `fix_revision` values are commits. 103 `head_commit_at_start` values are commits, and the other 3 are the missing round-18 runs. The repository has no tags.
- **Pre-freeze:** 11 of 11 checks pass in a fresh `--no-local` clone.
- **Wording:** the D-045 row makes no business or source-provenance claim. It correctly describes itself as the fourth and last commit-id field, completing D-044, not as a business requirement. Its census and "105 pass" claims are accurate.

**Finding**
- **F-DG0-015 (Low, not a mandatory violation, owner: delivery-orchestrator):** the D-045 heading says "all three reviewers PASS; each raised one Low". In fact the round-28 domain review raised no findings, and the same row's context column correctly says "domain PASS with no findings". It is a wording contradiction in an engineering record only.
  - I agreed in my verifications file that it can be accepted as an observation. That only takes effect if the release-auditor also agrees; otherwise it stays open.
  - If the wording is corrected instead, I'll re-verify it as closed in a later round.

My earlier findings F-DG0-013 and F-DG0-014 were already closed and verified. F-DG0-171 and F-DG0-251 belong to code-security and qa, so I didn't verify them; I only confirmed the fix behaves as described.

Records and evidence are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG0/round-29/` (the review record, narrative, findings and verifications files) and `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/domain/round-29/`. The record and findings file pass their schemas, and all 48 evidence paths exist. I removed my disposable clones. Leftover files from the test suites remain in the run's temporary directory, which the runner deletes at the end of the run.
